from recover_model import RecoveredModel

def main():
    # Load data
    sd_orig = torch.load('/app/weights.pt', map_location='cpu')
    data = torch.load('/app/dataset.pt', map_location='cpu')
    src = data['src_sequences']
    tgt = data['tgt_sequences']
    print(f"src shape {src.shape}, tgt shape {tgt.shape}")

    # Reconstruct model and load original weights
    model = RecoveredModel()
    model.load_state_dict(sd_orig)
    model.eval()

    # Freeze all except output_layer
    for name, p in model.named_parameters():
        if not name.startswith('output_layer'):
            p.requires_grad_(False)
        else:
            p.requires_grad_(True)
    # pos_encoder.pe is a buffer, ensure it stays frozen (buffers have no grad anyway)

    # Original MSE (teacher-forced: model(src, tgt) vs tgt)
    with torch.no_grad():
        out_orig_2 = model(src, tgt)
        mse_orig_2 = ((out_orig_2 - tgt) ** 2).mean().item()
        out_orig_1 = model(src)
        mse_orig_1 = ((out_orig_1 - tgt) ** 2).mean().item()
    print(f"Original MSE (src,tgt)->tgt: {mse_orig_2}")
    print(f"Original MSE (src)->tgt: {mse_orig_1}")

    # Tune ONLY output_layer via closed-form least squares on teacher-forced features
    # Collect decoder hidden states (input to output_layer)
    with torch.no_grad():
        src_emb = model.pos_encoder(model.embedding(src))
        memory = model.transformer_encoder(src_emb)
        tgt_emb = model.pos_encoder(model.embedding(tgt))
        H = model.transformer_decoder(tgt_emb, memory)  # [B,S,128]
        Hf = H.reshape(-1, 128)  # [400,128]
        Y = tgt.reshape(-1, 64)  # [400,64]
        Haug = torch.cat([Hf, torch.ones(Hf.shape[0], 1)], dim=1)  # [400,129]
        sol = torch.linalg.lstsq(Haug, Y).solution  # [129,64]
        W_opt = sol[:128, :].T.contiguous()  # [64,128]
        b_opt = sol[128, :].contiguous()  # [64]
        # Assign to output_layer
        model.output_layer.weight.data.copy_(W_opt)
        model.output_layer.bias.data.copy_(b_opt)

    # Verify frozen layers unchanged
    sd_new = model.state_dict()
    for k in sd_orig:
        if k.startswith('output_layer'):
            continue
        if not torch.equal(sd_orig[k], sd_new[k]):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Non-output layer changed: {k}")
    print("Frozen check passed: only output_layer differs.")
    print(f"output weight changed: {not torch.equal(sd_orig['output_layer.weight'], sd_new['output_layer.weight'])}")
    print(f"output bias changed: {not torch.equal(sd_orig['output_layer.bias'], sd_new['output_layer.bias'])}")

    # New MSE
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        out_new_2 = model(src, tgt)
        mse_new_2 = ((out_new_2 - tgt) ** 2).mean().item()
        out_new_1 = model(src)
        mse_new_1 = ((out_new_1 - tgt) ** 2).mean().item()
    print(f"Tuned MSE (src,tgt)->tgt: {mse_new_2}")
    print(f"Tuned MSE (src)->tgt: {mse_new_1}")
    assert mse_new_2 < mse_orig_2, "Tuned loss not lower (2-arg)!"
    # Also check 1-arg improved (teacher-optimal still improves src-only: 1.29 < 1.54)
    print(f"Improvement 2-arg: {mse_orig_2} -> {mse_new_2}")
    print(f"Improvement 1-arg: {mse_orig_1} -> {mse_new_1}")

    # Save TorchScript
    scripted = torch.jit.script(model)
    scripted.save('/app/model.pt')
    print("Saved TorchScript to /app/model.pt")

    # Verify saved model
    loaded = torch.jit.load('/app/model.pt', map_location='cpu')
    loaded.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        lmse2 = ((loaded(src, tgt) - tgt) ** 2).mean().item()
        lmse1 = ((loaded(src) - tgt) ** 2).mean().item()
    print(f"Reloaded scripted MSE 2-arg: {lmse2}, 1-arg: {lmse1}")
    # Check scripted can load original weights with no errors
    loaded.load_state_dict(torch.load('/app/weights.pt', map_location='cpu'))
    print("Reloaded scripted model load_state_dict(original) OK")
    # Restore tuned weights for final file (re-save since load_state_dict overwrote `loaded` only, not file)
    # File still has tuned weights; double-check file content
    sd_file = torch.jit.load('/app/model.pt', map_location='cpu').state_dict()
    # Compare file vs orig
    n_diff = 0
    for k in sd_orig:
        if k.startswith('output_layer'):
            continue
        if not torch.equal(sd_orig[k], sd_file[k]):
            print(f"MISMATCH in file: {k}")
            n_diff += 1
    print(f"File non-output mismatches: {n_diff}")
    assert n_diff == 0
    assert not torch.equal(sd_orig['output_layer.weight'], sd_file['output_layer.weight'])
    print("All verifications passed.")
